'''Fishing junk''' is the least valuable category of [[fishing]] loot. Since {{Version|1.12.7-beta}} it is the most common catch: in open water a catch is junk 62.5% of the time in a biome with fish (90.91% out of open water, where treasure can't be caught) and 68.75% of the time in Mushroom Fields and the [[Hell]] and [[The End|End]] biomes, which have no fish. {{MCW|Luck of the Sea}} lowers it (see [[Fishing#Choosing the catch]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing.json}}</ref>

Before {{Version|1.12.5}} the junk table couldn't be loaded: a trailing comma after the fish bones entry made the file invalid JSON, so in 1.12.4 a junk catch gave nothing. 1.12.5 removed the comma, and junk catches give items again.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/junk.json}}</ref><ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Fishing Junk LT Fixed (Not for modded biomes)}}</ref> Biomes added by other packs or mods are in none of the pack's climate tags. Since 1.12.7-beta those tagged as oceans or beaches fall back to the temperate saltwater table, and the others get the same fallback junk as the biomes without fish (see [[Fishing#Other biomes]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/worldgen/biome/fallback.json}}</ref>

== Loot ==
The table below is the junk table as it is written. All biomes share the base items. Three groups of biomes add one or two items of their own, which changes every item's share.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/junk.json}}</ref>

Jungles are Jungle, Sparse Jungle and Bamboo Jungle. Swamps are Swamp and Mangrove Swamp. Multiply a share by 0.625 for its chance per catch in open water in a fish biome (for example, a lily pad is 13.62% of all catches). Fish bones come from their own loot table, <code>matcha:materials/fish_bones</code>; since 1.12.6-alpha it gives a bone, which plays the fish bones catch sound and unlocks the [[Angler's Almanac]] entry.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/fishing_sounds/fish_bones.json}}</ref>

Estus Ash was added to junk so that players on Peaceful can get it.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Estus Ash added to Junk pool (For peaceful players)}}</ref> Most junk plays the junk [[fishing sounds|catch sound]]. Nautilus shells, fish bones, axolotls, frogs and tadpoles have their own.

{{History line|1.12.7-beta|The biome tables and the fallback junk became one weightless entry, so junk went from 10% to 62.5% of open-water catches in biomes with fish.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing.json}}</ref>}}
